dread.basis: Murders ordered one after another against a family the film names in advance, then poison administered to Mollie over months.

cruelty.basis: Contracted killings, a house bombing, a detective beaten, insulin poisoned by the victim's husband, hitmen murdered to cover tracks.

irony.basis: Hale 'poses as a friendly benefactor'; the closing radio drama recites the outcomes as entertainment, obituary omitting the murders.

ambiguity.basis: Perpetrators, method and motive stated as they happen; the coda supplies every sentence, parole and date of death.

fracture.basis: Chronological 1919 onward; only the buried-pipe prologue and the years-later radio epilogue sit outside the line.

dread.basis: Abduction, a Kurd's gang-rape threat and a death-threat note punctuate a story whose prevailing motion is erotic quest.

cruelty.basis: Zumurrud beaten for mocking a man, Aziz castrated with a rope, Aziza left to die of neglect, the thieves summarily executed.

irony.basis: The bet over who falls in love, and the crowd reading two executions as punishment for stealing rice, sit inside otherwise straight telling.

ambiguity.basis: The frame closes on Nur-e-Din reunited with Zumurrud; each inset tale is carried to its own end.

fracture.basis: 16 titled scenes with tales inside tales — Zumurrud's story, Dunya's dream, then Aziz's life read aloud from a book inside it.

dread.basis: A shooting, a police visit and repossession all arrive as farce; the gun turns out to fire blanks and the victim was pretending.

cruelty.basis: Andrée humiliated repeatedly and raped in the coal cellar at Walter's suggestion; parents conned of funeral savings; Luise dies unnoticed.

irony.basis: A poem plagiarised from George, an audience paid to attend, grief performed then 'declared to be acting', ending in shared laughter.

ambiguity.basis: The fake murder is explained, the blanks revealed, and Walter is stood back up — the last beat is everyone understanding the joke.

fracture.basis: One consecutive downward slide from the overdrawn account to the hospital and the final prank; no displacement.

dread.basis: Arnie's drunken gun threat and fatal crash are the only menace; the New York and Nevada stretches carry none.

cruelty.basis: Harm is self-inflicted or accidental — Sue Lynne's flaunting is the worst act, and she is given a scene of remorse.

irony.basis: The reserved stool, the postcards, the stolen kisses are played as earned sentiment with no distancing frame.

ambiguity.basis: Leslie's confession and the returned kiss close everything; only whether Arnie's crash was suicide is left as a suggestion.

fracture.basis: A single westward itinerary — New York, Memphis, Nevada, Vegas, back to the café — in order.

dread.basis: Merde's escalation from theft to hurling grenades at random citizens sustains threat; the other two segments have none.

cruelty.basis: Merde assaults schoolgirls and bombs passers-by, and a man tries to drag Hiroko home as furniture; the third segment is only gentle.

irony.basis: A woman becomes a chair and is grateful to be useful; a media frenzy and a court 'hungry for a satisfying resolution' around gibberish.

ambiguity.basis: Nothing explains the chair transformation or what Merde is, and he survives his own execution and vanishes into a vent.

fracture.basis: Three unconnected stories by three directors sharing only a city; each runs forward but no single order joins them.

dread.basis: Vicuña Porto's rumoured rapes and robberies hang over the whole outpost, then he turns out to be riding in Zama's own party.

cruelty.basis: Enslavement of indigenous people objected to and ignored, the captain killed, and Zama's hands cut off over jewels that don't exist.

irony.basis: The rival who bested him with Luciana is deported to Lerma — the posting Zama craves; his damning report buys only a letter the king ignores.

ambiguity.basis: Porto's identity rests on his own claim amid rumours everyone contradicts, and the film ends on a raft with Zama's future stated as uncertain.

fracture.basis: Consecutive stages of decline — outpost, new governor, expedition, mutilation — with large ellipses but no reordering.

dread.basis: The constable warns of a coming 'unofficial demonstration' on an indefinite date, and it lands at the wedding; then the three-day eviction.

cruelty.basis: A pogrom mid-celebration, Perchik exiled to Siberia, expulsion of the village — and Tevye declaring his own daughter dead.

irony.basis: Tevye's questions to God about the atrocities are put without any framing that undercuts them; the fabricated dream is his trick, not the film's.

ambiguity.basis: Every daughter's marriage is settled, the exile is executed, and Tevye's 'God be with you' resolves the last withheld blessing.

fracture.basis: Straight chronology from the milk round through three courtships to the departure down the road.

dread.basis: Worst outcomes are a lost job and a crashed van where 'no one is harmed'; nothing in the text threatens anybody.

cruelty.basis: Sharpest harm is Antoine telling Christine he never 'admired' her; the parents and the father forgive him at every turn.

irony.basis: Closing stalker declares 'permanent' love and Antoine recognises himself in him — the film tilts its own romance at the last beat.

ambiguity.basis: Engagement settles the plot, but the final 'He must be' leaves what Antoine's love is worth deliberately open.

fracture.basis: Strict forward chain: army, hotel, agency, shoe store, TV repair, proposal, park.

dread.basis: Harm has already happened (the coma); the tension is who caused it, not what will strike next — only Lucie's disappearance threatens forward.

cruelty.basis: Wife drinks bleach in front of Naïma; Lucie forwards the emails; Marie orders her daughter out — deliberate harm, but the film keeps revising blame rather than assigning it.

irony.basis: Every scene is people saying what they mean and being wrong; no gap between image and intent anywhere in the text.

ambiguity.basis: Text states outright it is unclear whether the wife is responsive, and the causal chain has been overturned three times before that.

fracture.basis: Single forward present; the past arrives as testimony inside scenes, never as displaced telling.

dread.basis: 23-hour arterial explosives set a running clock, and the trip inward is ambush after ambush — but the beats are action, not sustained expectation.

cruelty.basis: Fight to the death with Slag, Cabbie mined, Brain stepping on a mine, Maggie's sacrifice — deaths arrive fast and the film moves straight past them.

irony.basis: The summit tape plays 'Bandstand Boogie', the President offers half-hearted regret for the dead, and Snake destroys the real cassette.

ambiguity.basis: Mission completes, explosives neutralised, and the last shot tells us exactly what Snake did with the tape.

fracture.basis: Two dated title cards then one forward run; nothing is displaced.

dread.basis: A strangling opens it and Iris is disbelieved by everyone aboard a moving train, but the cricket banter keeps lifting the pressure.

cruelty.basis: Musician strangled, Todhunter shot while waving a white handkerchief — but the film rescues even the wounded false nun.

irony.basis: Charters and Caldicott's cricket obsession is played for laughs; the espionage plot itself is served straight.

ambiguity.basis: Miss Froy appears at the piano playing the tune — the one withheld fact is handed back in the last shot.

fracture.basis: Hotel, station, train, London, in that order, with no displacement.

dread.basis: The basement with torture devices is named early and hangs over everything; the opium vial exists solely as an exit from being taken there alive.

cruelty.basis: A child read sadistic pornography from age five, an aunt tortured to death and hung in the yard, Fujiwara worked over with bookmaking tools.

irony.basis: Part 2 re-runs Part 1's scenes to show every one of them meant the opposite — but the lovers themselves are played wholly straight.

ambiguity.basis: Every deception is retroactively explained, both men die on-page, and the women's escape is shown completed.

fracture.basis: Three labelled parts; Part 2 doubles back over Part 1 from the other side and nests childhood flashbacks inside it.

dread.basis: Constables pursue across the whole second half and Sakichi's past can surface at any moment — as it does, costing him his apprenticeship.

cruelty.basis: Ishimatsu shoves the stolen ornament into his brother's hand and runs; Genshichi beats him fatally and kidnaps Oyae; Sakichi kills him.

irony.basis: The thesis — society won't believe a conversion is genuine — is spoken aloud by Sakichi and then enacted without qualification.

ambiguity.basis: Ends mid-decision: Sakichi 'pondering in despair the choice between dying himself or turning to crime', with neither taken.

fracture.basis: Unbroken forward chain from release through apprenticeship, disgrace, flight and the final killing.

dread.basis: A killer with skates round his neck stalks Zhang, cuts down Wang mid-stakeout, and tampers with the bike — anyone near Wu is next.

cruelty.basis: Bodies dismembered and dropped into ice and coal trains; Rong Rong assaults Wu; Zhang sleeps with her to close the case and watches her driven away.

irony.basis: The romance is an investigation technique throughout, and the closing daylight fireworks answer a confession with a gesture.

ambiguity.basis: Both murder chains are fully explained in Wu's two confessions; only the meaning of the fireworks and the 'implied' identity is left open.

fracture.basis: One five-year jump from 1999 to the alcoholic present; everything else runs forward.

dread.basis: The largest stake is whether Frédéric undresses; nothing in the text can hurt anyone physically.

cruelty.basis: He leaves Chloé naked and waiting without a word, and Hélène breaks down — small deliberate wounds, and he stays to comfort her.

irony.basis: The amulet fantasy imports actresses from the earlier films in the series, and the text keeps quoting Frédéric's own self-justifications back at him.

ambiguity.basis: Hélène's tears go unexplained and the couple 'struggle to find the right words' — the decisive fact about that marriage is never given.

fracture.basis: One forward day-to-day line with a signalled fantasy sequence inset.

dread.basis: Slaughtered lamb and crucifixion open it, and the cottage holds a threat of scalding water and a woman being systematically studied.

cruelty.basis: Elisabet tears up her son's photo, writes Alma up as a specimen, and the film cuts in self-immolation footage and the Warsaw Ghetto photograph.

irony.basis: A projector starts and stops the film, a crew is shown filming Elisabet, and a boy reaches toward a screened image of the two women.

ambiguity.basis: Whether Elisabet ever speaks, whose story of the son it is, and whether the husband's visit happened all stay unsettled.

fracture.basis: Prologue of unattached images and a waking boy frames the whole; the projector stopping makes the film's own order provisional.

dread.basis: The only threatened harm is self-inflicted and arrives near the end; before that the pressure is entirely restraint and duty.

cruelty.basis: Liyan tells his wife he wishes she had married Zhichen; everyone is 'dutiful' and the film punishes none of them.

irony.basis: Yuwen's opening narration states the circular slowness of her life plainly, and the film shows exactly that.

ambiguity.basis: The choice is made — Zhichen leaves, Yuwen stays — but the final image on the wall says nothing about what remains between the couple.

fracture.basis: Forward season-length chronology; the narration is retrospective in voice only, never reordering events.

dread.basis: Ward under a predator's 'inescapable presence' for years, then illness, amputation, and a deathbed she engineers.

cruelty.basis: Guardian takes his 19-year-old ward as wife; she later stalls help during his heart attack and opens the window to finish him.

irony.basis: Lope preaches chivalry and leftism while preying on his ward; the film ends by running itself backwards to the seduction.

ambiguity.basis: Every motive stated—money, defiance, revenge—and the killing is shown outright; only the reverse coda unsettles.

fracture.basis: Forward across a five-year gap, then a closing montage that plays scenes in reverse back to the first seduction.

dread.basis: Arrests outside a memorial, border papers checked for resemblance to wanted terrorists, a fugitive bleeding in a doorway.

cruelty.basis: Kidnap-killing, disputed prison deaths, a woman buried alive quoted at both ends—harm reported and argued over more than staged.

irony.basis: Memorial gravity cut against caterers laying out snacks; producers debate a disclaimer then cancel Antigone entirely.

ambiguity.basis: The Stammheim 'alleged suicides' are left contested—Biermann's song and Mahler's interview both unpick the official version.

fracture.basis: Nine loosely intertwined episodes by different directors, fiction and archive footage, with no single order joining them.

dread.basis: Opens on the corpse and an accusation, but the recounted years are business and social climbing, not anticipated harm.

cruelty.basis: Veda's contempt is repeated and dwelt on—shame at the waitress job, the fake pregnancy, the sneer at the nightclub—then a shooting.

irony.basis: Melodrama played straight; the flashback confession is offered as truth, not undermined.

ambiguity.basis: Detectives admit they knew all along who fired; the frame closes with Bert waiting outside.

fracture.basis: One flashback told to police from a fixed present, returning to it for the reveal.

dread.basis: Deserted town, missing captain, converging feral army—and the coda alert that the extermination failed and they are back.

cruelty.basis: Severed heads on spikes, an assembly of self-mutilation and ritual execution shown, not implied.

irony.basis: The tribunal testimony and the last-stand ending are played straight; nothing in the text opens a gap.

ambiguity.basis: Whitlock explains the vault, the spirits, and the host-transfer rule; only the siege's outcome is left running.

fracture.basis: Testimony frame with flashbacks and 'flashbacks within flashbacks as new perspectives are incorporated'.

dread.basis: Affairs, contracts and drift; the one death arrives without any prior expectation of harm.

cruelty.basis: Cook holds the copyrights and keeps a wild lifestyle Rhonda can't bear until she kills herself; harm is passive, not lingered on.

irony.basis: Declarations of eternal love and a return to a father's bedside offered without any protective distance.

ambiguity.basis: Faye's stated disconnection is never explained, and her answers to her father are withheld—but the couplings all resolve.

fracture.basis: Episodic, elliptical drift between pairings with unstated intervals, yet always moving forward.

cruelty.basis: They rob poor farmers and a sick girl in priests' costumes, then beat, strip and abandon Augusto on a hillside to die slowly.

irony.basis: Fake clerics, but the pricked consciences and the dying man's 'wait for me' are given without distance.

ambiguity.basis: The hidden takings in his clothes settle whether he gave the money back; his death is shown to the last line.

fracture.basis: Straight forward run from the country scams through prison to the hillside.

dread.basis: A named assassin is introduced loading a gun before the credits and stays on the ship; the gramophone announces his arrival.

cruelty.basis: A magician and Kuvetli are killed, but as plot turns; nobody is lingered over in their harm.

ambiguity.basis: Haki names the plot, Muller is exposed and shot, and the letter frame is closed and torn up.

fracture.basis: Pre-credit teaser plus the whole story told as a letter, returning to the present to finish it.

dread.basis: One beating offscreen-adjacent; the rest is stranding and jealousy, with no ongoing expectation of harm.

irony.basis: The stolen photo and 'he knows where to find him' are offered without any undercutting.

ambiguity.basis: Ends on an admitted unknown—whether he will ever see Chang again—though every event before it is plain.

fracture.basis: Forward through the breakups and the departure; one 'meanwhile' cut to Po-Wing in the empty room.

dread.basis: Blackmail, then a maid roaming the house with rat poison, threats to the newborn, and a glass of water handed to a child.

cruelty.basis: The wife talks the maid into throwing herself downstairs to miscarry; a boy dies of a poison lie; the husband is talked into suicide.

irony.basis: The whole thing turns out to be a newspaper story the teacher was reading, and he ends by warning the audience directly.

ambiguity.basis: The frame retracts the events' status—'apparently' the teacher's telling—while the household's own facts stay fully spelled out.

fracture.basis: Circular: the opening newspaper-reading scene returns at the end and swallows everything between it.

dread.basis: Chases, a tightrope and escaped monkeys, all resolved into applause; the threat is comic mishap.

cruelty.basis: The stepfather treats Merna badly and slaps her, and the ringmaster underpays the Tramp knowingly—but harm is corrected, not dwelt on.

irony.basis: The heartbreak and the walk away are played for feeling, with no gap between what is shown and meant.

ambiguity.basis: Marriage settled, ringmaster silenced, and the Tramp's choice to stay behind is shown plainly.

fracture.basis: One forward run from the midway chase to the circus departing.

dread.basis: Death is routine and reversible by reprinting; real threat only lands late — memory backups destroyed, bomb vests, Creeper cull.

cruelty.basis: Scientists sacrifice iteration after iteration for a vaccine; Timo leaves 17 to die then comes to dismember him on contract.

irony.basis: Politician-leader, vat-grown meat, tail-collecting contest for the right to live — the frame is satirical throughout.

ambiguity.basis: All threads close: Creepers sentient, Marshall dead, program outlawed; only the Ylfa reprint-nightmare wobbles, then is explained.

fracture.basis: Straight forward order with a four-year voyage skip; one late nightmare-sequence insert that snaps back to the present.

dread.basis: Gang war, a knife ambush by an unknown assailant, a contract killing prepared over days, and a recurring nightmare about Saeko.

cruelty.basis: Muraki stabs Imai to death in a café as a gift-spectacle for Saeko; he pushes Shinko toward another man; Saeko is killed offscreen.

ambiguity.basis: Jiro is cut off before revealing Saeko's true identity, and the film keeps it withheld — Muraki decides it doesn't matter.

fracture.basis: Single forward order with stated gaps ('a week later', 'two years later') and one dream; nothing is displaced.

ambiguity.basis: Every strand settles: forgery exposed, cover-up denounced, Ishun banished, the lovers taken and crucified.

fracture.basis: Strict consecutive order, one household, cause following cause with no displacement.

dread.basis: Bombing and a collapse occur but arrive without buildup; the burglary is a prank, the war passes in a line, MPs arrive and smile.

cruelty.basis: Nobody harms anybody on purpose — students buy the neighbouring lot in secret to protect his sunlight.

irony.basis: 'Not yet' is offered wholly straight, and the closing hide-and-seek dream toward a golden sun has no defence against being laughed at.

ambiguity.basis: Vignettes close cleanly; only Nora's fate is left permanently unknown and the final dream is unglossed.

fracture.basis: Discrete vignettes across decades, but always forward — retirement, war, shack, new house, seventeenth banquet.

dread.basis: From the confession onward the husband's obsession builds through interrogation to rape and the stairs; harm is expected in every domestic scene.

cruelty.basis: He rapes her over her silence, keeps abusing her, throws her down the stairs and cripples her — the text stays for each stage.

irony.basis: Poverty, the one night of prostitution and the pleading reconciliation are all presented at face value.

ambiguity.basis: Facts fully known, but the embrace is left standing against her permanent injury without the film saying whether it holds.

fracture.basis: One continuous forward line from waiting for repatriation to the final embrace.

dread.basis: An announced 'destruction of a pure soul', a man who bought her a ring facing the man she loves, and a jealousy that ends in the corpse-vigil.

cruelty.basis: Taeko is kept as a mistress since childhood, then traded by dowry between men, then murdered by Akama; Kameda was nearly shot by a firing squad.

irony.basis: An intertitle states the thesis outright ('goodness and idiocy are often equated') and the film then delivers it without distance.

ambiguity.basis: 'Both, seemingly, die the next morning' — the one decisive fact is left unfixed after everything else is spelled out.

fracture.basis: Two labelled parts in forward order; the backstory of Akama and Taeko arrives as recounting, not as displacement.

dread.basis: An invisible threshold no one can cross, water running out, a corpse in the closet, the group deciding the host must die.

cruelty.basis: The guests turn on Edmundo and demand his death; two lovers kill themselves in a closet; soldiers fire on the crowd outside the cathedral.

irony.basis: Bear and sheep wander the salon, guests enter twice and greet three times, and manners persist while they use a closet as a toilet.

ambiguity.basis: No cause for the confinement is ever given, the repetition-escape works for no stated reason, and the cathedral traps everyone again.

fracture.basis: Repeated arrivals and thrice-played greetings, then a whole evening deliberately re-performed to the same words to unlock it.

dread.basis: Escalating shouting matches and one fight-induced labour, but no scene is spent expecting harm; the arc is careers and charts.

cruelty.basis: He abandons his wife at the hospital and refuses to see the newborn — deliberate, but the text moves straight on to success.

irony.basis: Songs, stardom and the stood-up ending are reported straight; nothing in the text shows the film undercutting its own images.

ambiguity.basis: Facts all settled; only the last beat — she turns back, he walks off — declines to say what either wanted.

fracture.basis: Continuous forward chronology from V-J Day through 'several years later' to the return to the same nightclub.

irony.basis: The lightning, the Pope's prophecy and the sword-shadow cross are all confirmed by the film as literally true.

ambiguity.basis: Prophecy fulfilled to the letter, Attila dead, the Empire reunited and Marcian crowned to public delight.

fracture.basis: Strict chronological march from Marcian's capture to the coronation.

dread.basis: Nothing threatens anyone; the one harm, Marie's pill overdose, arrives late and is stopped.

cruelty.basis: Alexandre sleeps with Veronika in Marie's bed, the film stays through Veronika's flaying monologue and Marie left sobbing.

irony.basis: Alexandre's lectures are framed as posturing — 'subtly but entirely self-absorbed' — yet the women's speeches are given straight.

ambiguity.basis: Ends on a maybe-pregnancy, an unanswered proposal and a man sitting on the floor; nothing is settled.

fracture.basis: One forward order, dated only by who is sleeping with whom.

dread.basis: Torture broadcasts, tumour-inducing signal, an abdominal slit taking tapes and guns — bodily threat never lifts.

cruelty.basis: The film's own subject is a show of victims tortured and murdered; whipping, Masha's corpse, Convex torn apart by tumours.

irony.basis: A media-war conspiracy satirised through eyeglass-company fronts, yet the hallucinations are staged with full commitment.

ambiguity.basis: Hallucination and event stop being separable; the final suicide is copied from a television image of itself.

fracture.basis: Told in strict forward order even as reality wobbles — no displacement of the telling.

dread.basis: Episodic tarot tableaux and rituals; no sustained expectation of harm to anyone in the group.

cruelty.basis: Castrating police chief, indoctrinating toymaker, population-reduction advisor — cruelty as emblem catalogued, not enacted.

irony.basis: 'Zoom back, camera!' reveals crew and lights, the immortals are dummies, and the audience is dismissed from the film.

ambiguity.basis: The quest is voided but the voiding is stated outright: 'Real life awaits us.'

fracture.basis: Discrete symbolic episodes — desert, tower, seven planets, island, ascent — but each follows the last.

dread.basis: LSD interrogation, hospital assassination, SWAT raid and stakeouts keep pursuit constant, but chases resolve into escapes.

cruelty.basis: Taped to a wheelchair and injected, a rod through the abdomen, the whole mailing list quietly killed off.

ambiguity.basis: Every thread explained: who programmed Jerry, who killed the judge, who Lowry works for, and the faked grave.

fracture.basis: Forward order with recovered memory at the stables supplying the one backward reach.

dread.basis: The assault and siege pass in one early scene; the rest is a domestic wait for the 3rd of the month.

cruelty.basis: Rape of an unconscious woman by her rescuer, then parents expelling her from the house and disbelieving her.

irony.basis: The rapist is disclosed, married with 'all duties, none of the benefits', then the couple are simply seen kissing happily.

ambiguity.basis: Paternity is fully disclosed; only the lap-sitting reconciliation with the father is left unaccounted for.

fracture.basis: Opens on the newspaper announcement, then jumps back to the citadel to reach it.

ambiguity.basis: The court splits — guilty verdict returned, then discounted; Nobile's own motives 'some correct, others wrong'.

fracture.basis: An imagined inquiry summons the dead as witnesses, and the expedition — including Amundsen's own death — is told inside it.

dread.basis: A stalking creature, a storm sealing the base, sabotaged furnaces and a posted watch — threat is constant but broken by procedure.

ambiguity.basis: Creature identified as plant life, electrocuted, reduced to ash, and the story filed to a roomful of reporters.

fracture.basis: Anchorage to Pole to resolution in one order, with no displacement at all.

fracture.basis: Single forward order from the contract killing to the shooting, no displacement anywhere.

fracture.basis: Continuous forward run from the Camden flat through Penrith and back, no displacement.

fracture.basis: Single forward order from the botched raid to the flight, no displacement
